counting_method: 100 registered source records + 900 governed source-learning targets
important_note: The 900 targets are deliberate learning tracks over authoritative source families, not a claim of 900 unrelated websites. This avoids fake or low-quality URLs while giving Buddy 1000 measurable curriculum targets.

generation_rule: For each of the 50 source families, create one governed learning target for each of the 18 learning tracks. Each target inherits the source's domain gain plus the track objective. 50 x 18 = 900 targets; combined with the first 100 registered source records, the curriculum reaches 1000 targets.

examples.expected_gain: Buddy learns how to discover and classify aerospace research while preserving source provenance.
Buddy learns to distinguish primary NASA evidence from secondary claims and retain lineage.
Buddy learns operational planning concepts from aerospace missions and applies them only in sandboxed simulations.
Buddy learns how research programs identify emerging capabilities and interdisciplinary opportunities.
Buddy learns to extract structured public-company disclosures while preserving filing provenance and avoiding unsupported financial conclusions.
Buddy learns to use labor-market time series for evidence-based forecasting with uncertainty.
Buddy learns structured safety-risk and recall analysis from authoritative transportation data.
Buddy learns to compare international development datasets and identify missingness, revisions and definitions.
Buddy learns to preserve provenance and distinguish guidance, evidence and uncertainty in global-health information.
Buddy learns process-quality concepts that can be converted into measurable engineering improvement experiments.
Buddy learns how communication standards fit together across interconnected infrastructure.
Buddy uses broad public knowledge only for discovery and cross-reference, then seeks authoritative evidence before learning it durably.
